result.one_liner: Telegram is a cloud-based messaging platform offering a free public Bot API (HTTP/JSON) for building bots and an MTProto client API for building custom Telegram clients.

result.notes: Telegram exposes two distinct public APIs: (1) the Bot API — free, instant self-serve via @BotFather, token-based auth appended to the request URL, REST-like HTTP/JSON, ~74-130+ methods depending on version; (2) the MTProto Client API — free self-serve registration at my.telegram.org yielding api_id/api_hash, but requires implementing the MTProto binary protocol and full user (phone-number) authorization, which is a heavier, non-REST integration (classified as auth "other"). No official Telegram-published MCP server found; several community MCP servers exist (chigwell/telegram-mcp, sparfenyuk/mcp-telegram, dryeab/mcp-telegram) wrapping either the Bot API or MTProto client libraries. Verdict is green because a fully functional agent toolkit (bot-based) is buildable today with zero-friction self-serve credentials.
